properties.title: PerceptionInput
properties.description: Schema for multimodal perception input records ingested by PerceptionAdapter. Captures source, modality type, raw data payload, and derived meaning.

properties.title: ProceduralPolicy
properties.description: Schema for FSM-driven procedural policy records. Represents state transitions with trigger conditions, effects, and reinforcement reward signals.

properties.title: ReflexionSnapshot
properties.description: Schema for AureusBridge reflexion / chain-of-thought snapshots. References a temporal input trace by UUID and captures thought steps, outcome, and feedback score.

properties.title: SymbolicGraph
properties.description: Schema for the symbolic graph store (SymbolicStore). File was absent from disk — node recorded as stub for graph completeness.

properties.title: TemporalEvent
properties.description: Schema for segmented ring-buffer temporal events indexed by TemporalIndexer. Carries agent tags, trigger classification, and decay weight.

properties.title: WorldModel
properties.description: Schema for world model state records (Dirichlet-Multinomial transitions, Kalman entity tracking, causal graphs). File was absent from disk — node recorded as stub for graph completeness.

edges.description: PerceptionInput events are ingested and stored as TemporalEvent records in the temporal ring buffer.
Temporal events are promoted to symbolic graph nodes by SymbolicStore when they reach relevance thresholds.
ReflexionSnapshot.input_trace (UUID) foreign-keys into a TemporalEvent record that triggered the reflexion cycle.
Temporal trigger_type field aligns with ProceduralPolicy trigger_condition, allowing FSM transitions to fire on temporal events.
ProceduralPolicy state transitions provide transition data consumed by the world model's Dirichlet-Multinomial state predictor.
Symbolic graph entity nodes are tracked as named entities inside the world model's Kalman entity tracker.
Reflexion outcomes are persisted as symbolic graph assertions after the AureusBridge chain-of-thought cycle completes.
